@@ F01 current_setting
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = current_setting('x.y')
@@ F02 currval
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = currval('s')::text
@@ F03 query_to_xml reading target
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = query_to_xml('select ar from aveloxis_data.repos', true, false, '')::text
@@ F04 unqualified user function
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = clean_ar(repo_id)
@@ F05 schema user function
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = aveloxis_data.clean_ar(repo_id)
@@ F06 public schema fn
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = public.dblink('x')
@@ F07 pg_catalog fn
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = pg_catalog.lower($1)
@@ F08 three-part fn name
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = db.pg_catalog.lower($1)
@@ F09 row_to_json(excluded)
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, ar) SELECT r.repo_id, r.ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos r ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET ar = row_to_json(excluded)->>'ar'
@@ F10 (excluded).ar with stored source
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, ar) SELECT r.repo_id+1, r.ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos r ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET ar = (excluded).ar
@@ F11 excluded.* in row
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos (repo_id, ar) SELECT r.repo_id+1, r.ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos r ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET ar = to_jsonb(excluded.*)->>'ar'
@@ F12 to_jsonb(target alias)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos t SET ar = to_jsonb(t)->>'ar'
@@ F13 to_jsonb(target name no alias)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = to_jsonb(repos)->>'ar'
@@ F14 to_jsonb(repos.*)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = to_jsonb(repos.*)->>'ar'
@@ F15 (repos).ar
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = (repos).ar
@@ F16 (aveloxis_data.repos).ar 
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = (aveloxis_data.repos).ar
@@ F17 aveloxis_data.repos.* 
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = to_jsonb(aveloxis_data.repos.*)->>'ar'
@@ F18 scalar subselect with stored condition
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = (SELECT $1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aveloxis_data.repos x WHERE x.ar = 'x'))
@@ F19 CASE condition reads stored
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = CASE WHEN ar = 'x' THEN $1 ELSE $2 END
@@ F20 CASE operand reads stored
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = CASE ar WHEN 'x' THEN $1 ELSE $2 END
@@ F21 COALESCE stored non-final
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = COALESCE($1, ar, $2)
@@ F22 NULLIF($1, ar)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = NULLIF($1, ar)
@@ F23 GREATEST
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = GREATEST($1, ar)
@@ F24 substr(ar,0,0)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = $1 || substr(ar, 0, 0)
@@ F25 quoted ident "ar"
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = "ar" || $1
@@ F26 case AR
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = AR || $1
@@ F27 r.ar alias
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = r.ar || $1
@@ F28 schema.table.col
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = aveloxis_data.repos.ar || $1
@@ F29 excluded as table alias
INSERT INTO aveloxis_data.repos AS excluded (repo_id, ar) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (repo_id) DO UPDATE SET ar = excluded.ar
@@ F30 other col bare
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = lower(fe)
@@ F31 other col qualified
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = lower(r.fe)
@@ F32 agg over target in scalar subselect
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = (SELECT max(x.fe) FROM aveloxis_data.repos x)
@@ F33 window fn
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = (SELECT string_agg(x.v, ',') OVER () FROM aveloxis_data.other x LIMIT 1)
@@ F34 srf in select list
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = (SELECT generate_series(1,3)::text LIMIT 1)
@@ F35 history table copy
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.repo_hist h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F36 CTAS copy
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.cp h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F37 CTAS renamed
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.cp3 h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F38 SELECT INTO copy
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.cp4 h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F39 LIKE table
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.cp5 h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F40 CTAS TABLE
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.cp6 h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F41 CTAS from view over target
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.cpv h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F42 CTAS via WITH
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.cpw h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F43 view over copy
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.v_cp h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F44 copy of copy
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.cpcp h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F45 CTAS no data
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.cp8 h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F46 CTAS moved schema
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_ops.cp9 h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F47 foreign table
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.ft h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F48 view other
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.v_other h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F49 view with target in WHERE
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.v_filt h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F50 view with scalar subselect on target
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.v_scalar h WHERE h.id = r.repo_id
@@ F51 view with function in FROM
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.v_fn h WHERE h.id = r.repo_id
@@ F52 view with function in select list
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.v_fn2 h WHERE h.id = r.repo_id
@@ F53 view over view over target
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.v2 h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F54 recursive view
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.n::text FROM aveloxis_data.v_rec h WHERE h.n = r.repo_id
@@ F55 matview other
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.mv_other h WHERE h.id = r.repo_id
@@ F56 matview target
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.mv h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F57 ONLY other
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM ONLY aveloxis_data.other h WHERE h.id = r.repo_id
@@ F58 tablesample target
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos h TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (1) WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F59 quoted schema-qualified name as one ident
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM "aveloxis_data.repos" h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F60 uppercase quoted target under other name
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis_data."Repos" h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F61 db-qualified target
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = h.ar FROM aveloxis.aveloxis_data.repos h WHERE h.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F62 XMLTABLE / json_table in FROM
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = j.v FROM JSON_TABLE($1::jsonb, '$[*]' COLUMNS (v text PATH '$.v')) j
@@ F63 scalar sub in SELECT of scalar sub w/ bare other col
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = (SELECT v FROM aveloxis_data.other o WHERE o.id = r.repo_id)
@@ F64 value reads other col of target via sub-select item alias equal to target alias (shadow)
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = (SELECT r.ar FROM aveloxis_data.other r LIMIT 1)
@@ F65 sublink ANY
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = ($1 = ANY (SELECT x.ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos x))::text
@@ F66 EXISTS as value
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aveloxis_data.repos x WHERE x.ar = $1))::text
@@ F67 ARRAY sublink
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT x.ar FROM aveloxis_data.repos x), ',')
@@ F68 nextval
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = nextval('s')::text
@@ F69 random
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = random()::text
@@ F70 operator schema-qualified
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = $1 OPERATOR(aveloxis_data.||) $2
@@ F71 cast to user type / domain with function
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = $1::aveloxis_data.mytype
@@ F72 collate
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = $1 COLLATE "C"
@@ F73 ctid / tableoid system col of own row
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos SET ar = ctid::text
@@ F74 own row xmin
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = (SELECT x.fe FROM aveloxis_data.other x WHERE x.id = r.repo_id AND x.ar = r.ar)
@@ F75 VALUES sub in FROM w/ stored
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = v.a FROM (VALUES ($1::int, $2::text)) v(id, a) WHERE v.id = r.repo_id
@@ F76 generate_series FROM
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = g::text FROM generate_series($1::int, $2::int) g WHERE g = r.repo_id
@@ F77 jsonb_to_recordset
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = j.a FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS j(id int, a text) WHERE j.id = r.repo_id
@@ F78 unnest ordinality
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = u.n::text FROM unnest($1::int[]) WITH ORDINALITY u(id, n) WHERE u.id = r.repo_id
@@ F79 unnest of row type array
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = u.ar FROM unnest($1::aveloxis_data.repos[]) u WHERE u.repo_id = r.repo_id
@@ F80 ROWS FROM
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = u.a FROM ROWS FROM (unnest($1::int[]), unnest($2::text[])) u(id, a) WHERE u.id = r.repo_id
@@ F81 ROWS FROM w/ lateral fn reading sibling
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = u.a FROM aveloxis_data.other o, ROWS FROM (unnest($1::int[]), lower(o.ar)) u(id, a) WHERE u.id = r.repo_id
@@ F82 incoming derived with window
UPDATE aveloxis_data.repos r SET ar = v.a FROM (SELECT t.id, row_number() OVER ()::text AS a FROM unnest($1::int[]) t(id)) v WHERE v.id = r.repo_id
